# package: #   SAFE  preinstalled extras, ads, tracking or rarely used; safe to disable (pm disable-user, undoable)
#   ASK   features some people use; only disable if the owner doesn't need it
#   KEEP  needed for the TV to work; debloat.sh refuses to disable these
# Anything not listed is shown as UNKNOWN and is left alone unless the owner is sure.
# Mostly from a TCL Google TV (Android 12); additions for other brands welcome.

description: Samba TV: watches what's on screen for ad targeting
TCL Channel: ad-supported channels, pushes rows to the home screen
TCL content feed: recommendations and ads
TCL Message Box: promo pop-ups and notices
TCL account (cloud login), runs in the background
TCL partner rows and the remote's T-button shortcuts on the Google TV home
Game Bar overlay in game mode
Google Assistant / voice search (the remote's mic button stops working)
Chromecast built-in (phones can't cast to the TV)
Google TV home: disabling it makes Google's setup app loop on Home
Google TV setup and its recovery screen
TCL Quick Panel and input switcher
